I work on making LLM evaluation trustworthy: knowing which model is actually better, and when its output can be trusted, when the labels, judges, and budgets behind the answer are imperfect.

For eleven years I've shipped machine learning to production at First American, AWS, and Western Digital. I have a PhD in operations research. [More about me →](about.qmd)
